label: TikTok

sources.covers: video restrictions of the Content Posting API (containers, codecs, frame rate, picture size, 10 min, 4 GB) — the strictest publishing path
in-feed ads: 9:16 >= 540x960, up to 10 min, <= 500 MB, >= 516 kbps, mp4/mov/mpeg/3gp/avi
secondary summary of the Help Center FAQs and API docs: app uploads up to 60 min, API 10 min / 4 GB, 1080x1920 recommended, mobile-app file limits (iOS ~288 MB, unofficial)
safe-zone margins at 1080x1920 (top 240, bottom 660, left/right 120, action column 300 px wide from y 840) derived from TikTok's ad safe-zone overlays

source_note: Technical limits are official (Content Posting API, Ads Help Center). TikTok publishes safe zones only as downloadable overlay images, not numbers, so the ui margins are widely cited creator guidance: ui (FAIL) = the area the caption, handle and buttons always cover; ui_caution (WARN) = where a long caption or the full action column can reach. rec_dur is creator guidance. App uploads accept up to 60 min; the 10 min limit used here is the API's.

video.moov_note: put it at the front so uploads and the API can start processing early (ffmpeg -movflags +faststart)
